_comment: Display WINDOWS for the 'new' badges. The RULE is NOT tunable and lives in code (normalize/model.effective_new_date): new-from-date = coalesce(posted_at, first_seen), excluding onboarding backfill, measured against the PULL DATE (never now()). Only the window lengths are parameters — every surface reads the same effective_new_date and differs only by how many days it allows. field/clock/exclude_first_pull are recorded here for documentation; they describe the fixed rule and are not switches.
